title: CAMA 5-Seed Results on Amazon item-ltv + Avito Negative Gate Init Fix
summary: Demo notebook for the CAMA (Cardinality-Aware Moment Aggregation) 5-seed experiment comparing mean aggregation vs CAMA variants on Amazon item-ltv and Avito ad-ctr GNN tasks. The notebook: (1) implements and unit-tests the CAMAAggregation module with gate_bias parameterization on synthetic data, (2) loads pre-computed 5-seed results, (3) performs statistical analysis (Cohen's d, paired t-test, Wilcoxon) comparing methods, and (4) visualizes per-seed MAE comparisons, training loss curves, and effect sizes. Key findings: Amazon CAMA degraded (d=-1.38), Avito CAMA-default was 4.7% worse, and negative gate init (gb=-3) failed the 5% safety check at 14.7% worse.
